description_en: Deletes a bootstrap action or a common script of an E-MapReduce (EMR) cluster
description_zh: 删除引导脚本或者普通脚本
kebab_example: aliyun emr delete-script --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id c-b933c5aac8fe0000 --script-type BOOTSTRAP --script-id cs-da7476a7679a4d4c9cede62ebe090000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteScript

parameters.description_en:
The type of the script. Valid values:

*   BOOTSTRAP: indicates a bootstrap action of the Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance.
*   NORMAL: indicates a common script.
parameters.description_zh:
脚本类型。取值范围：

- BOOTSTRAP：ECS实例引导脚本。
- NORMAL：普通脚本。
